annotations.title: Chercher des missions de bénévolat / Find volunteering missions

description: Find animal volunteering missions in France (shelters, wildlife, horses) near a town, in a department or nationwide, from API Engagement data. Use it to help someone volunteer. Returns up to 25 missions with organisation, place, dates and the Mission Museaux page to apply. Accepts French or English; replies in French, or English with langue "en".

commune.description: French town name or 5-digit postcode (string, 2 to 80 characters), e.g. "Nemours", "77140" or "Chaumont 52" (department number to tell namesakes apart). France only; a place abroad returns no result.

decalage.description: Number of missions to skip, for paging (whole number, 0 to 500, default 0), e.g. 10 for the second page of 10.

departement.description: Department or region instead of a radius (string): code or name, several separated by commas, e.g. "77", "2A", "Bretagne" or "75, 92, 93". A commune given with it only sorts by distance.

langue.description: Response language: "fr" (French, default) or "en" (English). A request written in English is answered in English even without it.

latitude.description: Latitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -90 to 90), e.g. 48.267. Give it with longitude, instead of commune.

limite.description: Number of missions to return (whole number, 1 to 25, default 10); a larger value is lowered to 25. Use decalage for the next page.

longitude.description: Longitude of the search centre in decimal degrees (number, -180 to 180), e.g. 2.693. Give it with latitude, instead of commune.

rayon_km.description: Search radius in km around commune or the coordinates (number, 1 to 100, default 30). Without a centre or departement, all of France.

type.description: Kind of mission: tous (all, default), benevolat (volunteering), service_civique (French civic service, ages 16 to 25) or volontariat (other volunteer schemes).

name: chercher_missions_benevolat

donnees.description: Where the missions come from: API Engagement, under the Licence Ouverte 2.0.

autres.description: The others, to ask for with their department (“Saint-Denis (93)”).

retenue.description: The town used, the most populous (“Saint-Denis (974)”).

homonymes.description: When several towns have exactly the given name and no department tells them apart; null otherwise.

indisponible.description: Present when no search could take place (missions not available here, or the daily copy not ready yet).

lieu_non_couvert.description: Present when the given town is not a French town: without a requested department, no search took place; Mission Museaux covers France.

raison.description: hors_france: a place abroad (Madrid, London); introuvable: no town of that name.

a_distance.description: Remote: non (on site), possible (partly) or complet (fully remote).

adresses.description: Number of addresses of the mission.

copiee_le.description: When Mission Museaux last read it from API Engagement (ISO date), daily.

debut.description: Start date (ISO), possibly past for an ongoing mission.

distance_km.description: Distance from the search centre to the closest address; null without a centre or a located address.

domaine.description: API Engagement field of action (“environnement”), as given.

fin.description: End date (ISO); missions ended more than a day ago are left out.

mise_a_jour_le.description: When API Engagement last updated the mission (ISO date).

organisation.description: The association or organisation offering the mission.

ouverte_aux_mineurs.description: true when open to minors, false when adults only, null when not stated.

plateforme.description: The platform that lists the mission (“JeVeuxAider.gouv.fr”).

publiee_le.description: When the mission was first published on that platform (ISO date), null when unknown.

source.description: Always api_engagement: a mission read from API Engagement, which gathers JeVeuxAider.gouv.fr and other platforms.

type_texte.description: The type in the response language.

url.description: The mission's page on Mission Museaux, with the association's full description and the Apply button; the only link to give.

ville.description: Town of the closest address (or the first one without a centre).
